text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Copano Rickey's recommendation, 
we visited a national park located in an 
auspicious direction.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, if it isn't Ricky-chan and 
the others. What a coincidence~."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, it's Acute-san~! I never thought 
I'd run into you in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We're here on a neighborhood association 
outing. Playing games together, having a 
barbecue—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, why don't the two of you join in as 
well? The neighborhood association 
president said it's totally fine to bring 
acquaintances along, too.
choice_data_list:
It looks fun, and if Rickey wants to join 
in...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wanna, I wanna!! Thanks for inviting me, 
Ms. Acute!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, good boys and girls! How about 
we play tag until lunchtime?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Big sis will be 'It', so run away as fast 
as you can, okay~? Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Children
text_block_list.text: Waaah!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Here! Fresh grilled carrots! They're hot, 
so be careful not to burn yourself!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're next! I know you said you hate 
vegetables, but I'm sure you can eat them 
if they're with meat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey busily grilled skewers and 
handed them out to everyone in the 
neighborhood. She seemed to be having fun, 
but—
choice_data_list:
It seems like you might forget about your 
own meals

It looks like you might forget about your 
own meals

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. In that case, let's 
set aside Rickey-chan's ingredients 
separately.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ha! Playing a ton, grilling meat, 
playing some more... I've stored up sooooo 
much great energy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrummmble~~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ahaha! Maybe I'm just a teeny bit 
hungry?
choice_data_list:
You've been running around without eating 
anything, after all.

You've been running around without eating 
anything, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I grilled some meat for you, Ricky-chan. 
There are plenty of seconds, so eat up, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here, have some tea too. Eat plenty, and 
get a good rest~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'll eat it, I'll eat it! The meat is 
so good~... ngk!?!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There, there, have some tea. Let me rub 
your back too~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's no rush, your food isn't going 
anywhere~. If you chew properly when you 
eat, you won't choke and you'll absorb all 
the nutrients.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, okaaaay...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems that even though she's usually 
the one taking care of others, when it 
comes to Wonder Acute, she ends up being 
the one looked after.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Mmm... mumble mumble...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, falling asleep before finishing 
the meal... Let's put a blanket over your 
lap so you don't catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it. I'm the one who should 
be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You tend to put yourself second like this 
all the time, Ricky-chan~. I was getting a 
little worried about you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...But now Rickey-chan has a Trainer 
who's truly looking out for her—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Please continue to look after 
Rickey-chan, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Please continue to look after 
Rickey-chan, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"If I recall... was it 'Soushou'? What 
Rickey calls a partner where you support 
each other mutually."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The moment you met Trainer, I'm sure 
Rickey-chan already became happy~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Mnh-mnh... Here I go, Traineeeer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could she be dreaming about a race...? 
Seeing Copano Rickey's peaceful sleeping 
face warmed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How reassuring! We can rest easy with 
this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What's that thing Ricky-chan always says? 
Ricky, lucky... umm—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, that. I'm super happy too~. 
Right, Rickey-chan?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh~... Everyone being happy... *mumble 
mumble*...
